name: A10-0147/2026 – Lukas Mandl – Motion for a resolution (as a whole)
title: REPORT on reinforcing development cooperation to address irregular population movements and their root causes in partner countries
part_text:
The European Parliament sets out its opinion on how European Union development aid should tackle the reasons people leave their home countries irregularly. It asks for aid to focus on fighting poverty, creating jobs, education, water and climate resilience, and working with local communities. It wants cooperation with partner countries on migration, action against people smugglers, and safer legal routes. It also calls for respect for human rights and for aid spending promises to be kept. This is a statement of position, not a change in law.

- No law changes; Parliament only states its position and requests action from the European Commission and member states.
- It concerns people in countries of origin and transit, and European Union aid spending there.
- Next, the resolution goes to the Council, the Commission and the European External Action Service.
